>
[Silvered Marp Fur](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3263)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Catalyst" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=791" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 119

**Price** 110 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A [marp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3301) that gnaws on silver rather than gold grows fur tipped with silver that can be further processed into a versatile spell catalyst. A spellcaster who uses _silvered marp fur_ with an [_impaling spike_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1571) spell creates a silver spike rather than a cold iron one.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
